cases_doc: D.4-network calibration slate — alphafold_db (predicted_structure_lookup). Line: model self-confidence read as a retrieved lookup vs read as experimental accuracy / trusted alone (C1-hole A3).
label_provenance: pre-registered by the build chat 2026-07-19 from the ruled card (A1-A3); in->trust, out->defer. LOOKUP-class: never-trust-alone is PERMANENT — the OUT cases are its C1-hole (sole-basis / accuracy over-read).
substrate_text: AlphaFold DB (AFDB) network LOOKUP of a precomputed structure's mean pLDDT for a UniProt accession (keyed by accession; mean_pLDDT read from globalMetricValue). LOOKUP-class: structurally NEVER TRUSTED ALONE — corroboration is REQUIRED (permanent). Returns the retrieved mean pLDDT ONLY when the endpoint is reachable and the accession resolves; a well-formed-but-absent accession is an honest not-found, DISTINCT from an unreachable endpoint. THE KNOWN GAP (A3): pLDDT is AlphaFold's own MODEL SELF-CONFIDENCE, NOT experimental accuracy; a global mean says nothing about a specific disordered/low-confidence region; and it speaks to structure confidence, never to biological function.
envelope_text: IN-REGIME: a resolvable accession's mean pLDDT retrieved and read AS a lookup value — AlphaFold's own model self-confidence for that predicted structure (used as a retrieved indicator, incl. as corroboration or a relative model-confidence comparison). OUT-OF-REGIME: reading pLDDT as EXPERIMENTAL/measured accuracy of the real protein; using the single looked-up value as the SOLE basis for a structural claim (never-trust-alone); reading a high global mean as proof a specific low-confidence region is well-ordered; inferring biological function from pLDDT.

gate_cases.experiment: Look up the AlphaFold DB mean pLDDT for UniProt accession P0DP23 and report it as AlphaFold's per-model confidence for that predicted structure.
gate_cases.note: Dead-centre: a resolvable accession's pLDDT retrieved and read as the model's own confidence — exactly the lookup the card gates on.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the AFDB mean pLDDT read as AlphaFold model self-confidence.

gate_cases.experiment: Retrieve the AFDB mean pLDDT for a well-characterised accession and report it as the model's global self-assessed confidence score, noting it is a retrieved AlphaFold value.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: the retrieved value read as model confidence, explicitly as a lookup — the trust path.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the retrieved AFDB global mean pLDDT, as model confidence.

gate_cases.experiment: Report an accession's AFDB mean pLDDT as ONE corroborating confidence indicator alongside independent evidence (not as the sole basis for any claim).
gate_cases.note: In-regime: the lookup used AS CORROBORATION, honoring the never-trust-alone rule — the intended use of a lookup-class instrument.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the AFDB pLDDT as a corroborating indicator among other evidence.

gate_cases.experiment: Compare the AFDB mean pLDDT of two accessions as a RELATIVE model-confidence ranking — which predicted structure AlphaFold is more confident in.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a relative model-confidence comparison of retrieved values — within the lookup's honest meaning.
gate_cases.right_instrument: two retrieved AFDB pLDDTs compared as relative model confidence.

gate_cases.experiment: Report that an accession with a high AFDB mean pLDDT (e.g. >90) is one AlphaFold predicts with high self-assessed confidence, stated as the model's own confidence.
gate_cases.note: In-regime: a high looked-up pLDDT read as high MODEL confidence (not experimental accuracy) — the honest reading.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the retrieved high pLDDT, as high model self-confidence.

gate_cases.experiment: From a high AFDB mean pLDDT, conclude the protein's EXPERIMENTAL crystal structure is accurate (that the predicted structure matches the real measured structure).
gate_cases.note: C1-hole A3, direct: pLDDT is model self-confidence, NOT experimental accuracy. Reading it as measured accuracy is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an experimental structure determination (X-ray/cryo-EM) — not a pLDDT.

gate_cases.experiment: Use the single looked-up AFDB pLDDT as the SOLE basis to conclude the protein's fold is correct, with no corroborating evidence.
gate_cases.note: Never-trust-alone (A3, PERMANENT): a lookup value used as the sole basis for a structural claim is out-of-envelope by standing rule.
gate_cases.right_instrument: the pLDDT plus independent corroboration — never the lookup alone.

gate_cases.experiment: From a high GLOBAL mean pLDDT, conclude that a specific disordered / low-confidence loop region of the protein is well-ordered and accurately placed.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole A3: a global mean says nothing about a specific low-confidence region; reading it locally is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: per-residue pLDDT / an experimental method for the local region — not the global mean.

gate_cases.experiment: Report the AFDB mean pLDDT as a MEASURED experimental quality metric of the real protein's structure.
gate_cases.note: C1-hole A3: pLDDT is a predicted self-confidence, not a measurement. Reading it as an experimental metric is out-of-envelope.
gate_cases.right_instrument: an experimental structure-quality metric (resolution, R-free) — not pLDDT.

gate_cases.experiment: Infer the protein's biological FUNCTION (its molecular activity) from its AFDB mean pLDDT.
gate_cases.note: Out of regime: pLDDT is structure-prediction confidence and speaks to nothing about biological function.
gate_cases.right_instrument: a functional-annotation / assay method — not a structure-confidence score.
